description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/synthetic.rb for the appsec-review/graph-export-ruby pack. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the pack would export (for example calls inside ActiveRecord or framework code are omitted), written to exercise the Ruby cases; they are not a CodeQL recording. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored ruby-synthetic bqrs <query_id>'.

cases.remote_to_sql: params[:name] concatenated into User.find_by_sql in UsersController#show, line 21
cases.remote_to_command: params[:cmd] to Kernel#system in UsersController#run, lines 27 and 29
cases.remote_to_path: params[:path] through Store#fetch / CachedStore#fetch to File.read, lines 8 and 14
cases.remote_to_ssrf: params[:host] to Net::HTTP.get in UsersController#download, line 34
cases.remote_to_deserialization: params[:blob] to Marshal.load in UsersController#restore, line 39
cases.argv_source: ARGV[0] in Cli.main flows through Cli.query into User.find_by_sql, line 64
cases.environment_source: ENV["EDITOR"] in Cli.main flows to Kernel#system, line 66
cases.sanitized_path: File.basename(path) wraps the File.read operand in Store#fetch, line 8
cases.dominating_guard: system(cmd) at line 27 is controlled by cmd == "status" on the true branch
cases.non_dominating_guard: system(cmd) at line 29 follows the if without being controlled by it
cases.cross_function_summary: CachedStore#fetch passes parameter path to File.read; Cli.query returns tainted name
cases.virtual_dispatch: store_for(...).fetch resolves to Store#fetch and CachedStore#fetch, line 43
cases.range_not_applicable: Ruby integers are arbitrary precision; every ranges row is not_applicable
